nameEn: Sale of motor vehicle parts and accessories
description: This class includes the wholesale and retail sale of all kinds of parts, components, supplies, tools and accessories for motor vehicles.
includes: wholesale and retail sale of motor vehicle parts and accessories: engines, tyres, wheels
wholesale and retail sale of motor vehicle electrical components
wholesale and retail sale of tools and equipment for servicing motor vehicles
retail sale of automotive fuel and lubricants
retail sale of car audio and entertainment systems
retail sale of motor oil and transmission fluid
excludes: retail sale of automotive fuel in specialised stores (service stations), see 4730
maintenance and repair of motor vehicles, see 4520
